mechanism: Ginseng may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing fluconazole levels, while fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and may affect ginseng metabolism; ginseng also has mild antiplatelet effects.
action: Monitor for increased fluconazole adverse effects (headache, QT prolongation) and bleeding signs; consider separating administration times or using alternative antifungal if polypharmacy concerns arise.
